identity_policy: A GitHub organization is official only when an official platform website, developer document or verified official social account links back to it. A matching name, search rank, stars or repository description is insufficient.

registry_dedupe.boundary: The shared registry was read only. This specialist does not modify shared ownership or integration state.

knowledge_package_policy.priority: inventory existing T One assets, then compare two or three pre-distilled packages, then open only official deep pages needed to verify disputed rules
required_checks: author or organization and official-identity evidence
owner/repo plus release or commit fingerprint
README, docs or changelog, release, recent commits, issues, pull requests, security and CI
credentials, telemetry, executable code and data-flow risks
country, site, store mode, ownership and seller-identity scope
one core workflow, one boundary or failure scenario and three key rules
overlap and the smallest merge location in the existing T One expert
knowledge_package_policy.installation_boundary: No candidate may be cloned, installed, executed, registered or copied into commercial code from this audit. A separate owner-approved connector review and a scoped successful read are required.

multichannel ecommerce ERP seller SOP checklist template evaluation SDK MCP ERP OMS PIM WMS

knowledge_packages.name: EcomPHP/lazada-php
knowledge_packages.commercial_boundary: Permissive license does not establish Lazada ownership, API correctness, seller authorization or T One integration approval.
credentials_telemetry_executable_risk: requires app_key, app_secret, callback URL, access and refresh token
Composer binary exposes an MCP server that reads undocumented ISV-console JSON handlers
README contains a ReadyToShip write example that must never be executed in research
knowledge_packages.t_one_overlap: High: T One already has country routes, credential references, approval gates, evidence registry and a planned per-store Lazada connector; this PHP runtime does not match the existing Python desktop path.

country_site_store_mode_ownership.seller_identity: stores one access token plus one region and does not persist country_user_info seller_id/short_code

sample_validation.core_workflow: Auth URL with state/country, code exchange, token plus region, then resource call was inspected statically; no credentials or live call were used.
sample_validation.boundary_or_failure: setAccessToken assigns the token before region validation; baseUrl silently defaults to VN when region is absent; resource tests mock method mapping instead of HTTP encoding, signing, seller scope or live responses.
three_key_rules_checked: CSRF state is desirable but not enforced as required by the package
a region string cannot replace country_user_info seller identity
method-mapping unit tests cannot prove transport or business completion

official_difference_check: current authorization page requires one-store token semantics and per-country country_user_info identity
official signing page appends the request body after sorted parameters
official request page says generic POST bodies are XML/UTF-8 and the app-specific official SDK remains the recommended path
merge_location: existing Lazada Skill SDK review gate

a region or ALL constant cannot replace a country seller identity
